sql: SELECT TOP 10 ad.Name AS templateName, o.ClassNumber AS templateNumber, ln.quantity AS quantity, tc.templateCount AS templateCount FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCPOrderClass oc ON oc.CPOrderClassId = o.ClassId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = o.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderAdditionalDetail ad ON ad.OrderId = o.OrderId CROSS APPLY (SELECT SUM(op.Quantity) AS quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT op.OrderProductId) AS lineCount FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderProduct op WHERE op.OrderId = o.OrderId) ln CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.OrderId) AS templateCount FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder t WHERE t.UserId = o.UserId AND t.PortalId = o.PortalId AND t.ClassId = o.ClassId) tc WHERE oc.ClassCode = @templateClass AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@owner IS NULL OR o.UserId = @owner) AND ln.lineCount >= @minLines AND tc.templateCount >= @minTemplates AND (@maxTemplates IS NULL OR tc.templateCount <= @maxTemplates) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR o.ClassNumber = @preferred) ORDER BY o.CreatedDate DESC, o.ClassNumber
